== Description ==

At the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025: [[Matt Scott]] (front left, black Nike track jacket with white stripes) playing [[Apollo Chu]] (front right, grey Alaska hoodie), with [[AJ Hatoum]] (back left) playing [[Mark Billings]] (back right, ponytail and patterned sweater) at the next table.
